WITH telescope_observatory AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS phase_avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescope_observatory
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
all_phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth) AS overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats
),
kept_phases AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.lunarstage,
    ps.phase_avg_bandwidth,
    ps.telescope_count,
    apm.overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN all_phase_mean apm
  WHERE ps.phase_avg_bandwidth > apm.overall_mean
)
SELECT
  AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth) AS avg_kept_bandwidths,
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes_kept,
  AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth - overall_mean) AS avg_excess
FROM kept_phases;
